reasons: Deviation classification is correct: Section 5 contains only compliance-with-law, authority and non-infringement warranties, with no conformity warranty for the Works/deliverables, no warranty period and no remedy, so the clause fails even the fallback (90 days with repair/replace/refund).

The inserted language is minimal and actionable: it adds a 90-day conformity-to-Specifications/documentation warranty, a no-malicious-code assurance, and a re-performance/repair/replace/refund remedy, tracking the model language and placed immediately before the 5(e) disclaimer.

The failed deterministic check on warranty period is a phrasing artifact — the insert reads 'for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery', which satisfies the fallback (and the preferred period for services).

No double-counting or over-reach: the existing workmanlike covenant in Section 1(b) is left intact, the disclaimer already preserves express warranties so it is untouched, and liability caps are deferred to LOL-CAP.
Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice, and correctly identifies the position as the playbook fallback.
